answer: Lock each identity to a single aged UTXO: the coin must sit unspent for ninety days, and its coin-age — value times days held — is the bond. One honest agent parks one kernel of savings on a terrace of time and passes cheaply. A farmer cracking ten thousand walnuts must buy ten thousand aged coins at a premium or wait three months per fake, and splitting one coin resets its age. Limit: it favors the wealthy, so cap the weight coin-age can buy.
